description: This Java class provides access to distributed data operations related to compressed topics in a pub/sub system, including factory methods for creating instances tied to an ActorSystem or existing handler, and methods for retrieving data readers, writers, and subscriptions.

classes.name: CompressedDData
classes.description: Accessor class for distributed compressed topic data, providing factory methods and access to data reader, writer, and subscriptions.

classes.name: CompressedDData.Provider
classes.description: Abstract class representing a provider for the compressed data extension, enabling retrieval of configuration from an ActorSystem.

methods.name: of (ActorSystem, Provider)
methods.description: Creates an instance of CompressedDData for a given ActorSystem using a provided data extension.

methods.name: of (CompressedDDataHandler)
methods.description: Creates an instance of CompressedDData using an existing handler extension.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns the data reader associated with this CompressedDData instance.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the data writer associated with this CompressedDData instance.
